name: Leader Iris
lines: “Welcome to the Lanternhall arena. Polished floors, polished team.”
“Every Steel Billie on my team makes the others hit harder.”
lose: “Not a scratch on them. Come back stronger.”
hint: Leader Iris’s Steel team is level 19–21. Fire and Ground moves hit Steel hard, and Steel shrugs off Psychic and Flying.

seat.title: Steel Badge · 2 of 8
seat.rewardText: a Shining Stone, 2 Gold Coins and a Platinum Coin
seat.unlockText: Route 11 · Hornpass, north of Verdigris City, is open, and snowy Frostcrown Town beyond it. A Billie big enough to ride can also carry you across Mirrormere Lake and the sea west of Marigold Town.
